plan: My value for the prize is $46. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly lower than my value to avoid overpaying. A bid of $45.9 ensures a win if others bid lower, and my profit will be $46 minus the third-highest bid. This bid minimizes the worst-case scenario where I win and pay close to my value.

My value is $17. To maximize profit, I aim to bid below my value to avoid overpaying. The worst-case scenario is winning with a bid equal to my value, resulting in no profit. A bid slightly below $17, such as $16.9, allows a chance to win while minimizing loss. This strategy ensures profit if the third-highest bid is lower than $16.9.

Considering my value of $28, I aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit while minimizing risk. Bidding slightly lower accounts for the worst-case scenario where I might overpay if others bid high. A bid of $27.9 ensures I still make a profit if I win and pay a third-highest bid close to the others'. This bid is competitive yet conservative, balancing potential gain and loss.
